description: Report a facility's air (Clean Air Act) or water (Clean Water Act / Safe Drinking Water Act) violations and the related compliance summaries. Set media to 'air', 'water', or 'all'. Requires an EPA Registry ID.

registry_id.description: EPA Registry ID (FRS ID), the numeric facility identifier returned by epa_facility_search (e.g. '110001136271').

name: epa_water_or_air_violations
